modalLead: A status page for the people who use your services, and a dashboard that opens quicker.

items.text: A page for the people who use your services. Turn it on under Config → Status page and share the link: they see your groups, whether each service works, planned maintenance and 30 days of history, without getting into your dashboard.

Set it up from top to bottom in Config → Status page: the link with Copy and a QR code, the top of the page, groups of services (a bookmark or container you already have counts as one service) and maintenance windows per group.
Unraid has tabs, like the other sections, so the page no longer jumps when you move between them. A small new in the section list marks what is new or reworked.
Bookmarks and the dashboard draw faster with many bookmarks and containers: category titles are fitted together, and containers are matched to their bookmarks once instead of for every row.
Choosing a theme no longer leaves an older version of the colours in front when you change themes twice in quick succession.
With several of your own themes, the theme file is no longer downloaded again after every change you make.
Pasting a link the Inbox already holds opens a styled Inbox on a freshly loaded page, instead of a bare list.
